changes.text: 魏公子在魏国以养客知名。《史记》说他「公子為人仁而下士，士無賢不肖皆謙而禮交之」，不敢以富贵骄士，以致食客三千人，方圆数千里的士人争相投奔。这些门客不只是排场：有一回他和魏王下棋，北境举烽报警，说赵寇将入界，公子说是赵王田猎，不久北边传话果然如此。魏王问何以知晓，他说门客中有人能得赵王阴事。

The Wei prince was known in Wei for keeping retainers. The Grand Historian writes, in translation, that he was humane and humble toward men of talent, treating every scholar, worthy or not, with courtesy and respect, never presuming on wealth and rank — so that he had three thousand retainers, and men of ability from a radius of several thousand li competed to attach themselves to him. They were not mere pageantry. One day, while he was playing a board game with the king of Wei, beacon fires on the northern frontier signaled a Zhao raid about to cross the border. The prince said the king of Zhao was out hunting, nothing more. Word later came from the north confirming exactly that. Asked how he knew, he explained that among his retainers was a man who could ferret out the king of Zhao's private business.
细节上更该存疑的是：「得選兵八萬人」这个数字只此一处，无旁证；晋鄙军中实际如何合符，证据未载；侯生许诺北乡自刭以送公子，证据只记这句许诺，是否践行、动机为何均未载；侯生所献窃符之计如何执行，证据未载。

The detail most worth doubting: the figure of eighty thousand picked men appears here alone, with no corroboration; how the tallies were actually matched in Jin Bi's camp is not recorded in the evidence; Hou Ying's pledge to cut his own throat to see the prince off is recorded only as a single sentence — whether he carried it out, and why, is not in the evidence; and how Hou Ying's scheme to steal the tally was carried out is not recorded in the evidence.
本篇只有一个史源（《史记·魏公子列传》一处记述），对话与献计是史家记述，未必逐字；「心不快」「意驕矜」「立自責」是叙述用语而非实录心理；不换算公元年份；“得选兵八万人”仅此一处、无旁证；晋鄙军中实际如何合符，证据未载；侯生北乡自刭只见于其许诺之语，是否践行及动机证据未载；侯生所献窃符之计如何执行，证据未载。

This piece rests on a single historical source (one account in the Biography of the Wei Prince in the Records of the Grand Historian). The dialogue and the proposed scheme are the historian's rendering and need not be verbatim; the prince's displeasure, self-congratulation and self-blame are narrative labels rather than recorded psychology; years are not converted to the common era; the figure of eighty thousand picked men appears in this one place with no corroboration; how the tallies were actually matched in Jin Bi's camp is not recorded in the evidence; Hou Ying's throat-cutting appears only as a pledge — whether he carried it out, and why, is not in the evidence; how Hou Ying's scheme to steal the tally was carried out is not recorded in the evidence.

dispositions.rationale: 删去证据不支持的量化判断“一半来自养客／rested half on his retainers”。中文改为“以养客知名”，英文同步改为“was known in Wei for keeping retainers”。证据只记士人争相归附、食客三千。

evidence.quote: 士以此方數千里爭往歸之，致食客三千人

dispositions.rationale: 证据只记侯生许诺届时北乡自刭以送公子，没有记载他实际自刭。已把“自刭的动机只写行为和一句话／comes down to an act”改为“只记这句许诺，是否践行、动机为何均未载”，中英同步。

evidence.quote: 請數公子行日，以至晉鄙軍之日，北鄉自剄，以送公子

dispositions.rationale: 证据包中关于合符只有侯生的假设性预案，无法支持对原文全篇“没有记载”的断言。已收窄为“晋鄙军中实际如何合符，证据未载”，与同段末句的口径一致，中英同步。

evidence.quote: 公子即合符，而晉鄙不授公子兵而復請之，事必危矣

dispositions.rationale: 与 V1-V2 同样处理：改为“侯生北乡自刭只见于其许诺之语，是否践行及动机证据未载”，英文同步为“appears only as a pledge”，不再把许诺写成已发生的行为。

evidence.quote: 請數公子行日，以至晉鄙軍之日，北鄉自剄，以送公子

dispositions.rationale: 与 V1-V3 同样处理：把“原文未载”收窄为“晋鄙军中实际如何合符，证据未载”，英文同步为“is not recorded in the evidence”。

evidence.quote: 公子即合符，而晉鄙不授公子兵而復請之，事必危矣
